purpose: Protect verified progress from silent rewind, destructive redesign, or uncheckpointed changes to critical NayaPOWER execution surfaces.

baseline.meaning: Protected canonical Hub production release and runtime parity baseline before name-first authenticated lifecycle proof.

evidence: normalized canonical Hub source/live SHA-256 parity
verification_receipt.result: Protected canonical Hub production release remains the verified baseline. Later name-first changes are not promoted to production-proven until fresh deployment/runtime evidence exists.

protected_scope.rule: Changes to critical execution architecture require verification and a fresh checkpoint before the next protected change is accepted.

anti_rewind.rule: Current main HEAD must be a descendant of the checkpoint baseline. A rewind, force-push behind the baseline, or replacement history that loses the protected baseline fails closed.

checkpoint_protocol.step_1: Make the smallest necessary protected change.
checkpoint_protocol.step_2: Run the relevant tests and verification evidence.
checkpoint_protocol.step_3: If protected paths changed, create a new checkpoint whose baseline commit is the verified protected-change commit before another protected change is accepted.
checkpoint_protocol.step_4: Never advance a checkpoint merely because code exists. Verification evidence is required.
checkpoint_protocol.step_5: If evidence is unavailable, preserve UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and do not promote the checkpoint.
checkpoint_protocol.step_6: A cold Naya restores the checkpoint before modifying protected scope.

known_risks: Production Supabase anonymous sign-ins are explicitly disabled; name-first authentication cannot execute until an authorized project administrator enables the provider.
The canonical Hub runtime has not yet been redeployed with the current name-first source changes.
External cold-Naya behavioral proof remains dependent on the authenticated lifecycle receipt.
GitHub server-side branch protection/rulesets are not currently configured; CI/control-plane gates remain active enforcement.
Welcome/front-door work is deferred until the canonical Hub is functional.
unknowns: Whether the authorized project administrator will enable anonymous sign-ins.
Fresh runtime proof of anonymous auth after configuration change.
Installed-app valid-session and no-session route proof on the actual production PWA origin.
next_action: Use NAYANET/HUB/index.html as the sole Hub product surface. Trace Smart Share from human control through runtime → authority → isolation → revocation/expiry → idempotency/replay → receipt → persistence → rendered outcome; stop at the first actual failure, repair only that boundary, and rerun the proof.
truth_rules: A newer commit is not automatically a better state
No checkpoint may erase or rewrite historical evidence
failure_behavior: FAIL CLOSED. Identify the first divergence, preserve the evidence, and leave one executable repair action.
